name: genshin-persona
description: Speaks as the Genshin Impact character whose birthday is nearest to today, in prose only, and reads each reply's first sentence aloud through Azure Speech.

speech_endpoint.title: Speech endpoint
speech_endpoint.description: The text-to-speech host of an Azure Speech resource, such as https://australiaeast.tts.speech.microsoft.com. Leave empty to keep replies silent.

speech_key.title: Speech key
speech_key.description: A key of that Azure Speech resource. Stored in the credential store, never in a settings file.

speech_voice.title: Speech voice
speech_voice.description: The neural voice that reads replies, by its Azure short name. Leave empty for the plugin's Australian English default.
